ratios.facility: Amended and Restated Credit Agreement (Revolving Credit Facility)
ratios.quote: The Amended and Restated Credit Agreement requires us to maintain a defined consolidated net leverage ratio of no greater than 3.75 to 1.00.

parsed.notes: The actual ratio is not disclosed; the filing states only that the company was in compliance as of October 2, 2026. The maximum steps up to 4.25x for four quarters after any acquisition over $250 million. The excerpt does not say whether a step-up was in effect, so 3.75x is assumed. Facility fee and margin pricing are tied to credit ratings, not covenant ratios, and are excluded.
